reason: Small, localized change broadening accepted input types for the all_route_data liquid tag (from Dictionary<string,string> to any IFluidIndexable, filtering to string values), which is low-risk but could subtly change behavior for existing templates passing non-Dictionary objects or non-string route values that previously worked differently.
